entities.name: Kang Joon-Ho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kang Joon-Ho was a South Korean amateur boxer who won the bronze medal at the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was born in Haeju, Korea, Empire of Japan, and died in Seoul, South Korea. He has multiple grandchildren, including Benjamin Im and Ray Im.
